title: A szabadságharc és a tavaszi hadjárat (The War of Independence)
grammar: Political Declarations, Subjunctive Demands & 1848 Narrative Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name the main events of the Spring Campaign of 1849.
I can put battle events in order with miután, miközben and mielőtt.
I can say who Franz Joseph asked for help.
I can use six new words about the Honvéd army and the Spring Campaign.
